interpretation: For TDS at Outfall 001 (permit footnote *6, PARAMETER_CODE 70295), workspace sources establish that weekly values must be aggregated as a geometric mean for reporting and that permit compliance is framed around reported aggregate statistics rather than raw single-sample comparison; however, the parent geometric_mean obligation cannot be resolved uniformly because the same DMR comment text is structurally attached to non-TDS parameters whose permit footnotes (*1–*5) carry no geometric-mean requirement. Candidate aggregate_before_compare is source-established only for the TDS footnote *6 occurrence; applies_to_all_comment_rows and ordinary_single_period are contradicted for misattached non-TDS rows; reporting_only is contradicted for TDS by Part I items 3–4.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether any geometric-mean comment row outside PARAMETER_CODE 70295 inherits TDS footnote *6 comparison semantics; whether stored DMR_VALUE_NMBR values are already geometric means of weekly samples or raw monitoring-period quantities; whether geometric mean (footnote *6) or weekly average (Part I items 3–4 wording) is the exact comparison statistic; permit narrative was not cross-checked against every parameter in the 40 structured rows.
